title: Normalized total tensor comparison with the quotient-linear scalar cone
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a site essentially small in the coefficient universe, let $R$ be a commutative ring sheaf and $t$ any global section. Use [def-sp-regular-scalar-quotient-notation]. For all natural $n,m$ there is a chain isomorphism $e:Q_n[0]\otimes_R K_m\simeq p_{n,*}P_{n,m}$ carrying the two specified tensor inclusions in degrees $-1,0$ to the restrictions of the corresponding cone inclusions. Neither regularity of $t$ nor an ordering of $n,m$ is required.

source.place: First proof paragraph: the displayed coefficient tensor and its two cohomology objects.

proof.text: In the total tensor formula [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], $B_n[0]$ has only degree zero, so only the summands $B_n\otimes_R R$ in degrees $-1,0$ survive. The unit formulas of step 2 identify them with $B_n$; the differential is $1\otimes t^m$, with sign $(-1)^0=1$, and sends $b\otimes r$ to $b\otimes t^mr$, hence becomes multiplication by $t^m$. The degree-zero augmentation is $b\otimes r\mapsto\operatorname{red}(b)\bar r$ in $B_m$, defined using the quotient $B_n\to B_m$ since $t^nR\subseteq t^mR$. Under $b\otimes r\mapsto rb$ it is coefficient reduction. These balanced local formulas define maps of the sheaf tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Restriction of scalars carries the two cone inclusions to the same summands and the scalar differential to multiplication by the image of t^(m+1). These equalities give the two normalization equations of the chain isomorphism. The calculation works for every pair n,m.

lean.statement:
theorem regularScalarQuotient_tensorComparison (n m : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : tensor R t n m ≅ restrictedP R t n m,
      tensorIn R t n m (-1) (koszulLeft R t m) ≫ e.hom.f (-1) =
        (res (projection R t n)).map
          (leftIn (B R t n) (scalarImage R t (projection R t n))
            (unit (B R t n)) (m + 1)) ∧
      tensorIn R t n m 0 (koszulRight R t m) ≫ e.hom.f 0 =
        (res (projection R t n)).map
          (rightIn (B R t n) (scalarImage R t (projection R t n))
            (unit (B R t n)) (m + 1))
